plan.purpose: Fully automatic eight-class score fusion versus standalone and recalibration controls
plan.inputs: concatenated base and specialist log softmax scores clipped at 1e-6; 16 inputs; canonical class order
plan.scaling: unweighted mean and population standard deviation of capped fit sample only; constant columns scale one
plan.fit_rows: unchanged 270326-row class-capped sample from existing grouped fit partition
plan.heads: six joint heads, six base-only heads, three shared specialist-only heads; all frozen before audit
plan.calibration: unused; no threshold or hyperparameter selection
plan.audit: existing 408027-row group-preserving audit; already explored in earlier stages, not independent confirmation
plan.continuation_screen: In all six seed/lane pairs, fusion macro-F1 exceeds every control and Web-based and Brute Force F1 each exceed base; report false-alert changes separately, never infer operational acceptance
plan.latency: local CPU in-memory inference, batches 1 and 512, three warmups and thirty timed repeats; no input preprocessing, network, disk or physical edge claim
